name: Pride and Prejudice
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: Pride and Prejudice was written by Jane Austen, first published in 1813.
Follows Elizabeth Bennet as she navigates family, reputation, and her prickly first impressions of the wealthy Mr. Darcy -- one of the most widely read novels in the English language.
Discussion prompt: Social Class is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
